title: cBioPortal web-API metadata adapter
context: An adapter that transforms cBioPortal public metadata (the /api study + clinical-attribute endpoints) into a valid canonical record, for the pinned API version recorded in specVersions. Open tier only, with golden captured-response fixtures diffed in CI. No partner is yet secured, so verifiedNeed is false and requestor is TO BE SECURED.
objective: Deliver a cBioPortal web-API metadata adapter that emits valid canonical records from public metadata, with golden fixtures and CI, as a PR.
acceptanceCriteria: Transforms the source's public metadata response into a valid canonical record for the pinned API version (recorded in specVersions): cBioPortal /api study/clinical-attribute.
Ships committed golden captured public-metadata response -> expected canonical record fixtures, diffed in CI; output validated against the canonical-model schema.
Open tier only: the adapter never requests authenticated/controlled-access endpoints.
Code MIT-licensed; unit tests + CI green; no credentials embedded; no individual-level data in fixtures.
